TECH CORPS is searching for a Full Time Program Manager to join us as we work to Educate, Excite and Empower K-12 students! This is not your typical nonprofit job!

As a Program Manager, you will be primarily responsible for managing the day to-day tasks for designated TECH CORPS programs throughout the year including, developing and supervising TECH CORPS programs, employees and our volunteer network. Reporting to the Director of Operations, you will be responsible for ensuring adequate resources are in place to carry out programming and expanding the impact of TECH CORPS in the region.  

Who is TECH CORPS?
For more than 25 years, TECH CORPS has worked to ensure K-12 students have equal access to Computer Science (CS) and Information Technology (IT) programs, skills and resources that enhance early learning and prepare them for college, credential or career.

What Do We Do?
We design computer science and IT programs that are rigorous, relevant and fun. We recruit, train and support technology talent to implement TECH CORPS programs. We work with partners, who believe as we do and together, we provide students and teachers access to programs designed to educate, excite and empower.

Job Title: Full-Time Program Manager at TECH CORPS

Responsibilities:
- Manage day-to-day tasks for designated TECH CORPS programs throughout the year.
- Develop and supervise TECH CORPS programs, employees, and volunteer network.
- Ensure adequate resources are in place to carry out programming and expand the impact of TECH CORPS in the region.
- Work closely with the Director of Operations and the Central Ohio Regional Steering Committee to develop goals and plans for expanding TECH CORPS’ impact across the region.
- Develop and maintain partnerships with a diverse group of program implementation partners.
- Implement, support and evaluate TECH CORPS programs in the region.
- Recruit, train and support TECH CORPS staff and volunteers to implement programs.
- Recruit student participants and interact with families.
- Increase TECH CORPS’ visibility in the Central Ohio region.
- Assist with program and grant reports.
- Perform other duties as necessary.

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of experience with formal/informal education and/or nonprofit.
- Ability to take initiative, work independently and manage multiple projects without close supervision.
- Bachelor’s degree in any field is a plus, but not required.
- Planning, organizational, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Experience recruiting and managing staff and volunteers.
- Experience working collaboratively and effectively with diverse groups.
- Working knowledge of the Central Ohio technology and/or K-12 education ecosystem is a bonus.
- Demonstrated knowledge of STEM initiatives with a particular focus on technology and computer science is a bonus.
- Experience with using and creating spreadsheets for data is a bonus.

Job Title: Full-Time Program Manager at TECH CORPS

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Program Manager position at TECH CORPS. As a Manager of Engagement at the Gateway Film Center from 2019 to 2022, and an Assistant Editor in the middle school science editorial department at McGraw-Hill from 2006 to 2008, I have extensive experience in both formal and informal education, as well as working in the nonprofit sector. I am confident that my skills and experience align with the position requirements and that I would be an asset to your team.

At Gateway Film Center, I managed multiple projects without close supervision, recruited and managed staff and volunteers, and increased the organization's visibility in the community. I developed and supervised programs that were designed to educate, excite, and empower diverse audiences. These programs required me to work collaboratively with a variety of partners to ensure that adequate resources were in place to carry out the programming.

Similarly, as an Assistant Editor in the middle school science editorial department at McGraw-Hill, I planned, organized, and communicated effectively with diverse teams to develop rigorous, relevant, and engaging content for K-12 students. I was responsible for recruiting and managing staff and volunteers to implement the program and interacted with families to ensure their needs were met.

Additionally, I possess the planning, organizational, and communication skills required for this position, both written and verbal. I have experience using and creating spreadsheets for data, and I have a working knowledge of the Central Ohio technology and K-12 education ecosystem. 

I am excited about the opportunity to work with TECH CORPS to ensure that K-12 students have equal access to computer science and information technology programs, skills, and resources that enhance early learning and prepare them for college, credential or career. I look forward to contributing my skills and experience to expand TECH CORPS’ impact across the region.

Thank you for considering my application. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
